info.title: ChronoCompass Moment API
info.description: Public read-only API using the same calendar and wheel solvers as the UI. No authentication. Unknown/duplicate query parameters are rejected. Bounds are half-open. All public timestamps are seconds.

schema.description: Unix seconds, at most 3 fractional digits; omitted = server clock captured once. Gregorian years -9999..9999. Millisecond timestamps are rejected.
IANA zone supported by Node ICU/TZDB; absolute instant is unchanged.

Cycle.description: Wheel cycles include spokes. harmonic_long_cycles instead includes greatCycle, age and wave periods with elapsedCalendarDays and fraction. See registry descriptions and documented units.

utcDatetime.description: ISO 8601 UTC; signed six-digit extended years for BCE dates.

units.*Fraction: unitless fraction; elapsed time, not angular phase

cycles.description: Great Cycle, age and wave/X interval; civil-day progress.
Lunar synodic cycle. E=first quarter, N=full, W=last quarter, S=new. Spokes rounded to minutes.
Tropical seasonal cycle. E=March equinox, N=June solstice, W=September equinox, S=December solstice. Approximate polynomial model.
Sun–Mercury distance cycle. E=rising midpoint, N=maximum, W=falling midpoint, S=minimum.
Sun–Venus distance cycle. E=rising midpoint, N=maximum, W=falling midpoint, S=minimum.
Sun–Earth distance cycle. E=rising midpoint, N=maximum, W=falling midpoint, S=minimum.
Sun–Mars distance cycle. E=rising midpoint, N=maximum, W=falling midpoint, S=minimum.
Sun–Jupiter distance cycle. E=rising midpoint, N=maximum, W=falling midpoint, S=minimum.

Sun–Neptune distance cycle. E=rising midpoint, N=maximum, W=falling midpoint, S=minimum.
Sun–Pluto distance cycle. E=rising midpoint, N=maximum, W=falling midpoint, S=minimum.
Earth–Moon distance cycle. E=rising midpoint, N=maximum, W=falling midpoint, S=minimum.
Moon orbital nodes. E=ascending node, W=descending node, N/S=latitude extrema.
Mercury orbital nodes. E=ascending node, W=descending node, N/S=latitude extrema.
Mercury synodic cycle, looker=Earth, focus=Sun. Spokes rounded to minutes.
